facts.fact: The handbook says the Eswatini DroughtMap Hub, run with the National Drought Management Center, Ministry of Agriculture and Meteorological Service, computes a Combined Drought Indicator from CHIRPS and MODIS satellite data and publishes it per inkhundla in a public area.
The handbook says the Combined Drought Indicator is computed automatically each month for the previous month, then reviewed, validated and published.

systems.platform: GeoNode, Django and NextJS web app
systems.owner: National Drought Management Center, Ministry of Agriculture, Eswatini Meteorological Service
systems.tiers: public area for visitors; admin and reviewer areas
